jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Technology & Operations design and integrate software applications ranging from portfolio management systems, trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations and developing custodian and funds administration services.

This function is in the Clients & Assets Services department, in the Asset Data Management unit.

Your role

As a Banking Operations Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing the opening and pricing of a diverse range of financial products. This includes a wide scope of assets, such as listed products (equities, bonds, loans, derivatives), OTC products (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD), and structured products (autocall, reverse convertible, dual currency deposits, accumulators, airbags). You will manage the entire workflow, from trade reception and integration into the bank's database, through lifecycle management, to instrument pricing.

Another aspect of the role will be to manage our complex platform and its development, working closely with our Product Analyst.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.

• Monitor and publish asset data, prices, Greeks, market data, and analytics across all supported platforms.

• Manage the lifecycle of all assets from an asset data perspective (Corpac events, openings, unwinds).

• Provide support to various users of this data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).

• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.

• Liaise directly with key stakeholders in case of issues.

• Implement the necessary configurations for queries and data/pricing flows for newly registered securities from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).

• Regularly review and update these settings.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.

• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.

• Solid technical skills, particularly with data management tools and financial platforms.

• Background in mathematical finance.

• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.

• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

Soft skills:

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with various teams and stakeholders.

• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.

• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.

• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone.

Progettazione e integrazione di applicazioni software che vanno dai sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading alle soluzioni bancarie e aziendali. La divisione è responsabile di alcune delle innovazioni chiave del Gruppo, sostenendo le operazioni aziendali e sviluppando i servizi di gestione dei fondi e dei depositari.

Questa funzione è nel reparto Clienti e Servizi, nell'unità Asset Data Management.

Il tuo ruolo

In qualità di responsabile delle operazioni bancarie, sarai responsabile della supervisione dell'apertura e dei prezzi di una vasta gamma di prodotti finanziari. Questo include una vasta gamma di beni, come prodotti elencati (equità, obbligazioni, prestiti, derivati), prodotti OTC (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity opzioni, TRS, CFD), e prodotti strutturati (autocall, reverse convertible, doppio deposito valuta, accumulatori, airbag). Potrai gestire l'intero flusso di lavoro, dalla ricezione commerciale e l'integrazione nel database della banca, attraverso la gestione del ciclo di vita, ai prezzi degli strumenti.

Un altro aspetto del ruolo sarà quello di gestire la nostra complessa piattaforma e il suo sviluppo, lavorando a stretto contatto con il nostro Product Analyst.

• Integra e controlla le aperture di asset sulla nostra piattaforma globale, Neoxam.

• Monitorare e pubblicare dati, prezzi, greci, dati di mercato e analisi su tutte le piattaforme supportate.

• Gestire il ciclo di vita di tutti i beni da una prospettiva di dati di asset (Eventi Corpac, aperture, disavvolti).

• Fornire supporto a vari utenti di questi dati (contabili per fondi di investimento, valutatori, amministratori, asset manager, gestori di ricchezza, ecc.).

• Sfida vari tipi di asset contro i prezzi della controparte.

• Liaise direttamente con gli stakeholder chiave in caso di problemi.

• Implementare le configurazioni necessarie per query e flussi di dati/presa per i titoli di nuova registrazione dai nostri vari fornitori di informazioni finanziarie (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).

• Regolarmente rivedere e aggiornare queste impostazioni.

Il tuo profilo

Esperienza richiesta:

• Laurea magistrale in finanza, economia.

• Da 2 a 5 anni di esperienza minima in una posizione simile con una forte comprensione dei prodotti finanziari e delle strutture di mercato.

Competenze dure:

• Forte comprensione dei prodotti finanziari.

• Competenze tecniche solide, in particolare con strumenti di gestione dei dati e piattaforme finanziarie.

• Sfondo in finanza matematica.

• Abilitato utente di applicazioni software di ufficio, in particolare Excel.

• Capacità di programmazione: VBA, SQL o un'altra lingua è un bene.

Morbide competenze:

• Capacità di gestire più compiti e progetti con versatilità in un ambiente dinamico.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per lavorare con vari team e stakeholder.

• Forte mentalità analitica e attenzione ai dettagli, con un approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi.

• Una mente che indaga con forti capacità di apprendimento e una facoltà critica ben sviluppata.

• Accuratezza e completezza nella ricerca delle informazioni necessarie per valorizzare i titoli.

• Buona capacità di collaborare e trovare una soluzione win-win.

Capacità linguistiche:

• Francese: livello fluente

• Inglese: buona conoscenza (scritto e parlato)

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. Tale documento sarà richiesto con l'obiettivo di effettuare un controllo del carattere sui candidati, tenendo presente l'area di attività del nostro stabilimento e, più in particolare, i compiti descritti nella descrizione del lavoro.

Modi flessibili e moderni di lavoro

In qualità di datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo il benessere dei nostri dipendenti attraverso una serie di modalità di lavoro flessibili, che vanno da una politica di lavoro-da-casa per funzioni ammissibili a opportunità di congedo part-time annualizzato e congedo parentale prolungato.

Diversità e inclusione

Dein Team

Die Pictet Group ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit 1989 in Luxemburg präsent und beschäftigt dort über 700 Mitarbeiter.

Technology & Operations entwerfen und integrieren Softwareanwendungen, die von Portfoliomanagementsystemen, Handelsplattformen bis hin zu Bank- und Unternehmenslösungen reichen. Die Division ist für einige der wichtigsten Innovationen der Gruppe verantwortlich, während sie den Geschäftsbetrieb aufrechterhält und Depot- und Fondsverwaltungsdienste entwickelt.

Diese Funktion befindet sich in der Abteilung Clients & Assets Services, in der Einheit Asset Data Management.

Deine Rolle

Als Banking Operations Officer sind Sie für die Überwachung der Eröffnung und Preisgestaltung einer Vielzahl von Finanzprodukten verantwortlich. Dies umfasst eine breite Palette von Vermögenswerten, wie börsennotierte Produkte (Aktien, Anleihen, Kredite, Derivate), OTC-Produkte (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity-Optionen, TRS, CFD) und strukturierte Produkte (Autocall, Reverse Convertible, Doppelwährungseinlagen, Akkumulatoren, Airbags). Sie verwalten den gesamten Workflow, vom Handelsempfang und der Integration in die Datenbank der Bank über das Lifecycle-Management bis hin zur Instrumentenpreisgestaltung.

Ein weiterer Aspekt der Rolle wird die Verwaltung unserer komplexen Plattform und ihrer Entwicklung sein und eng mit unserem Produktanalysten zusammenarbeiten.

• Integrieren und kontrollieren Sie Asset-Eröffnungen auf unserer globalen Plattform Neoxam.

• Überwachen und veröffentlichen Sie Asset-Daten, Preise, Griechen, Marktdaten und Analysen auf allen unterstützten Plattformen.

• Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus aller Assets aus der Perspektive der Asset-Daten (Corpac-Ereignisse, Eröffnungen, Abwicklungen).

• Unterstützung verschiedener Nutzer dieser Daten (Buchhalter für Investmentfonds, Bewerter, Administratoren, Vermögensverwalter, Vermögensverwalter usw.).

• Fordern Sie verschiedene Anlagetypen gegen die Preise der Gegenpartei heraus.

• Kontaktaufnahme mit den wichtigsten Interessengruppen im Falle von Problemen.

• Implementieren Sie die erforderlichen Konfigurationen für Abfragen und Daten- / Preisflüsse für neu registrierte Wertpapiere von unseren verschiedenen Finanzinformationsanbietern (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).

• Überprüfen und aktualisieren Sie diese Einstellungen regelmäßig.

Dein Profil

Geforderte Erfahrung:

• Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft.

• 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung mindestens in einer ähnlichen Position mit einem starken Verständnis von Finanzprodukten und Marktstrukturen.

Hard Skills:

• Starkes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte.

• Solide technische Fähigkeiten, insbesondere mit Datenmanagement-Tools und Finanzplattformen.

• Hintergrund in der mathematischen Finanzierung.

• Erfahrener Benutzer von Office-Software-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel.

• Programmierkenntnisse: VBA, SQL oder eine andere Sprache ist ein Asset.

Soft Skills:

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Projekte mit Vielseitigkeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu bewältigen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten, um mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu arbeiten.

• Starke analytische Denkweise und Liebe zum Detail, mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

• Ein forschender Geist mit starken Lernfähigkeiten und einer gut entwickelten kritischen Fakultät.

• Genauigkeit und Gründlichkeit bei der Suche nach den Informationen, die für die Bewertung von Wertpapieren erforderlich sind.

• Gute Fähigkeit, zusammenzuarbeiten und Win-Win-Lösungen zu finden.

Sprachkenntnisse:

• Französisch: fließend

• Englisch: gute Kenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen)

Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 kann von Bewerbern verlangt werden, einen Auszug aus ihrem Strafregister vorzulegen. Dieses von den Behörden ausgestellte Dokument darf nicht älter als drei Monate sein. Ein solches Dokument wird mit dem Ziel angefordert, eine Charakterprüfung der Kandidaten unter Berücksichtigung des Tätigkeitsbereichs unserer Einrichtung und insbesondere der in der Stellenbeschreibung beschriebenen Aufgaben durchzuführen.

La division est responsable de certaines innovations clés du Groupe tout en soutenant les opérations commerciales et en développant les services de gardiennage et d'administration des fonds.

Cette fonction se trouve dans le service Services aux clients et aux biens, dans l'unité Gestion des données d'actifs.

Votre rôle

En tant qu'agent des opérations bancaires, vous serez chargé de superviser l'ouverture et la tarification d'une gamme variée de produits financiers. Cela comprend un large éventail d'actifs, tels que les produits cotés (équités, obligations, prêts, dérivés), les produits OTC (IRS, CDS, options FX & Equity, TRS, CFD) et les produits structurés (autocall, convertibles inversés, dépôts en double devise, accumulateurs, coussins gonflables). • Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration pour travailler avec diverses équipes et parties prenantes.

• Forte attitude analytique et attention aux détails, avec une approche proactive de la résolution des problèmes.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank’s strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business‑process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. Participation in a periodic 24/7 on-call shift is required.

Your role

• Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.

• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.

• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.

• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.

• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.

• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Automate recurring tasks through scripts, workflows and tooling in collaboration with development and operations teams

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and data-protection requirements.

Your profile

• Master's degree / Engineering degree in Computer science

• Fluent in french and english

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a banking environment or fund administration

• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

• Good knowledge of cloud environments from major providers (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), with a sound understanding of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS service models.

• Solid knowledge enabling effective use of Kubernetes and Docker infrastructures, including operations, scaling and monitoring.

• Proven hands-on experience with scripting and automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell, orchestration tools).

• Working knowledge of systems and networking (Linux/Unix, Windows Server, core networking fundamentals) to support diagnosis and troubleshooting, without acting as a day-to-day system administrator.

• Familiarity with DevOps concepts and Site Reliability Engineering practices, including reliability indicators, capacity management and scalability.

• Good command of SQL and ability to work with data in Oracle, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) databases, as well as sound knowledge of Prometheus for metrics collection and analysis.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to remain composed during critical incidents, strong communication skills (including in English), and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-specialists.

• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including business teams, IT teams and external partners.

• Good knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change and Configuration Management), with the ability to apply them pragmatically in a critical IT production environment.

• Understanding of business processes related to fund administration / transfer agency and the associated regulatory framework.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.

Your role

• Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.
• Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
• Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
• Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
• Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.
• Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
• Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
• Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
• Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
• Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.

Your profile

• A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
• At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
• Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
• Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
• Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
• Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
• Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
• Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
• Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
